key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: やっほー! ジムに着いたみたいね。

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信システムは大ホールに直接つながってるから、どこにいても、ジムに着いたらいつでもアドバイスをもらえるのよ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それはそうと……

key: AME: So you're going to fight Shelly, right?
en: AME: So you're going to fight Shelly, right?
ja: アメ: それじゃ、シェリーと戦うのね?

key: By the way, did you know that some Leaders in Reborn choose to fight in Double Battles?
en: By the way, did you know that some Leaders in Reborn choose to fight in Double Battles?
ja: ところで、リボーンには、ダブルバトルで戦うことを選ぶリーダーもいるって知ってた?

key: Shelly is one of those. Her tag team strategy focuses on setting up rain to cover her Fire-type weakness, and then going for a safe sweep.
en: Shelly is one of those. Her tag team strategy focuses on setting up rain to cover her Fire-type weakness, and then going for a safe sweep.
ja: シェリーもその一人よ。彼女の戦略は、雨を降らせてほのおタイプへの弱点をカバーして、それから安全に一掃するっていうものなの。

key: If you don't let her set the rain up, Fire-type attacks in her Forest Arena will make short work of her.
en: If you don't let her set the rain up, Fire-type attacks in her Forest Arena will make short work of her.
ja: 雨を降らせる隙を与えなければ、彼女の森の闘技場でのほのおタイプの攻撃で、あっさり片がつくわ。

key: But, if the rain does come, go with the flow and use Water moves to ride that wave!
en: But, if the rain does come, go with the flow and use Water moves to ride that wave!
ja: でも、もし雨が降ってしまったら、流れに乗って、みずタイプのわざでその波に乗っかりなさい!

key: Many of her bugs won't resist it, so that extra power can be her own undoing.
en: Many of her bugs won't resist it, so that extra power can be her own undoing.
ja: 彼女のむしポケモンの多くはそれに耐性がないから、その追加の威力が彼女自身の首を絞めることになるわ。

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張ってね!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: 大ホールの方、誰も出ないみたいね……

key: Jump?
en: Jump?
ja: 飛び込みますか?

key: Are you here to do research too? Or just fight?
en: Are you here to do research too? Or just fight?
ja: あなたも研究をしに来たの? それとも戦うだけ?

key: Ah, but don't hurt the books, please!
en: Ah, but don't hurt the books, please!
ja: ああ、でも本を傷つけないでくださいね!

key: She's shy about it, but Shelly is one of the smartest girls around.
en: She's shy about it, but Shelly is one of the smartest girls around.
ja: 恥ずかしがってるけど、シェリーはこの辺りでも指折りの賢い子なんですよ。

key: She even set up this sliding bookcase puzzle!
en: She even set up this sliding bookcase puzzle!
ja: このスライド式本棚パズルまで作ったんです!

key: Each computer lifts or raises a few different ones.
en: Each computer lifts or raises a few different ones.
ja: それぞれのコンピューターが、いくつか違う本棚を上げ下げするんですよ。

key: The screens show which cases are affected!
en: The screens show which cases are affected!
ja: どの本棚が動くかは、画面に表示されます!

key: I will demonstrate the power of knowledge!
en: I will demonstrate the power of knowledge!
ja: 知識の力をお見せしましょう!

key: It is hereby superceded by the power of Pokémon themselves.
en: It is hereby superceded by the power of Pokémon themselves.
ja: それは、ポケモン自身の力によって、ここに上書きされるものとする。

key: Most of these books are at a college level, but Shelly has no trouble reading them.
en: Most of these books are at a college level, but Shelly has no trouble reading them.
ja: ここの本の大半は大学レベルなんですけど、シェリーは苦もなく読んじゃうんですよ。

key: This puzzle is also at a college level, but I think I have it figured out.
en: This puzzle is also at a college level, but I think I have it figured out.
ja: このパズルも大学レベルなんですけど、僕はもう解けたと思います。

key: It's with the three in the front...
en: It's with the three in the front...
ja: 手前の三つがポイントで……

key: Get the sides as high as possible, and the center low.
en: Get the sides as high as possible, and the center low.
ja: 両端をできるだけ高くして、真ん中を低くするんです。

key: Then when you're out, raise the center.
en: Then when you're out, raise the center.
ja: それで、出たら真ん中を上げる。

key: I think.
en: I think.
ja: だと思います。

key: Oh, I didn't think I'd be bothered here.
en: Oh, I didn't think I'd be bothered here.
ja: あら、ここで邪魔されるとは思わなかったわ。

key: Not that I meant you were bothering me, per se.
en: Not that I meant you were bothering me, per se.
ja: 別に、あなたが邪魔だと言ったわけではありませんのよ

key: I just like coming here to read quietly.
en: I just like coming here to read quietly.
ja: ただ、ここで静かに本を読むのが好きなだけ。

key: Though it's sometimes difficult with everyone trying to figure out the bookcase puzzle.
en: Though it's sometimes difficult with everyone trying to figure out the bookcase puzzle.
ja: もっとも、みんながあの本棚パズルを解こうとしてると、時々大変だけど。

key: If I remember correctly, there's a computer only accessible from Shelly's room.
en: If I remember correctly, there's a computer only accessible from Shelly's room.
ja: 確か、シェリーの部屋からしか操作できないコンピューターがあったはずよ。

key: But, that's the last one to use.
en: But, that's the last one to use.
ja: でも、それは最後に使うものね。

key: Hello. Do you come here often?
en: Hello. Do you come here often?
ja: こんにちは。よくここに来るの?

key: I come here every day. It's so nice to relax.
en: I come here every day. It's so nice to relax.
ja: 毎日来てるわ。くつろげてすごくいいの。

key: Being able to grab any book you want and just lay in the grass-- so clean!-- and read the day away...
en: Being able to grab any book you want and just lay in the grass-- so clean!-- and read the day away...
ja: 好きな本を手に取って、草の上に――すごくきれいなの!――寝転がって、一日中読んで過ごせるなんて……

key: It really helps me escape from the city's industrial gloom.
en: It really helps me escape from the city's industrial gloom.
ja: 街の陰気な工業地帯から、本当に逃げ出せる気分になるわ。

key: Oh, this puzzle? I just know you need to walk on top of some of the bookshelves to get to Shelly.
en: Oh, this puzzle? I just know you need to walk on top of some of the bookshelves to get to Shelly.
ja: ああ、このパズル? シェリーのところに行くには、本棚の上を歩かなきゃいけないってことしか知らないわ。

key: SHELLY: Um... I'm really sorry about last time.
en: SHELLY: Um... I'm really sorry about last time.
ja: シェリー: ええと……この前は本当にごめんなさい。

key: I probably just got lucky.
en: I probably just got lucky.
ja: たぶん、運が良かっただけだと思うの。

key: Let's um-- Do you wanna try again?
en: Let's um-- Do you wanna try again?
ja: それじゃ、ええと――もう一回やってみる?

key: Good l-luck!
en: Good l-luck!
ja: が、頑張って!

key: SHELLY: What did you think of my garden library?
en: SHELLY: What did you think of my garden library?
ja: シェリー: あたしの庭の図書室、どうだった?

key: Sorry, I'm kind of a bookworm~
en: Sorry, I'm kind of a bookworm~
ja: ごめんね、あたしちょっと本の虫だから~

key: Hehe...
en: Hehe...
ja: えへへ……

key: Actually, I just spent a lot of time reading so I could be good enough for my brother.
en: Actually, I just spent a lot of time reading so I could be good enough for my brother.
ja: 実は、お兄ちゃんに認めてもらえるくらいになりたくて、たくさん本を読んでただけなの。

key: He's so cool.
en: He's so cool.
ja: すごくかっこいいの。

key: He's a Gym Leader in Johto!
en: He's a Gym Leader in Johto!
ja: ジョウトでジムリーダーやってて!

key: I wanted to be just like him, so I came here to do this!
en: I wanted to be just like him, so I came here to do this!
ja: お兄ちゃんみたいになりたくて、それでここに来てこれをやってるの!

key: But no matter what I did, it was never enough.
en: But no matter what I did, it was never enough.
ja: でも、何をやっても、十分だったことなんてなくて。

key: He always just p-pretended like I didn't exist.
en: He always just p-pretended like I didn't exist.
ja: お兄ちゃんはいつも、あたしなんかい、いないみたいに振る舞ってて。

key: It's fine though, I know my place.
en: It's fine though, I know my place.
ja: でも、いいの、自分の立場はわかってるから。

key: Sorry, we kinda got off topic... So...
en: Sorry, we kinda got off topic... So...
ja: ごめんね、話が逸れちゃった……それで……

key: You're here to fight, of course.
en: You're here to fight, of course.
ja: 戦いに来たのよね、もちろん。

key: Um, as-- As a heads up, some Leaders fight in Doubles!
en: Um, as-- As a heads up, some Leaders fight in Doubles!
ja: ええと、そ、そうだ、一部のリーダーはダブルバトルで戦うの!

key: Like me, I prefer it, because...
en: Like me, I prefer it, because...
ja: あたしもそうなんだけど、それが好きなのは……

key: Because, well, I think it's nice for at least my Pokémon to have friends to fight alongside?
en: Because, well, I think it's nice for at least my Pokémon to have friends to fight alongside?
ja: その、少なくともあたしのポケモンには、一緒に戦う友達がいた方がいいと思うから?

key: Anyway, um-- Let's get started...!
en: Anyway, um-- Let's get started...!
ja: それじゃ、ええと――始めましょう……!

key: SHELLY: So, um... Good luck!
en: SHELLY: So, um... Good luck!
ja: シェリー: それじゃ、ええと……頑張ってね!

key: ...I'm still not good enough, huh...
en: ...I'm still not good enough, huh...
ja: ……やっぱり　わたしじゃ　だめなんだ……

key: SHELLY: Yeah...
en: SHELLY: Yeah...
ja: シェリー: うん……

key: I probably never will live up to his expectations.
en: I probably never will live up to his expectations.
ja: あたし、多分一生お兄ちゃんの期待には応えられないんだと思う。

key: N-not like this, at least...
en: N-not like this, at least...
ja: す、少なくとも、こんな風には……

key: But... But it's okay, you did really well!
en: But... But it's okay, you did really well!
ja: で、でも……大丈夫、あなたはすごく上手だった!

key: Um...
en: Um...
ja: ええと……

key: \PN received the Cocoon Badge!
en: \PN received the Cocoon Badge!
ja: \PNはまゆバッジを受け取った!

key: SHELLY: Um, since you have that Badge now, Pokémon up to level 40 are probably gonna like you.
en: SHELLY: Um, since you have that Badge now, Pokémon up to level 40 are probably gonna like you.
ja: シェリー: ええと、そのバッジがあれば、レベル40くらいまでのポケモンなら言うこと聞いてくれると思う。

key: It also lets you use the move Rock Smash outside of battle.
en: It also lets you use the move Rock Smash outside of battle.
ja: それに、バトル外で「いわくだき」も使えるようになるの。

key: And um...
en: And um...
ja: それと、ええと……

key: Um, oh!
en: Um, oh!
ja: あ、そうだ!

key: Here, take this, please?
en: Here, take this, please?
ja: はい、これ、受け取ってくれる?

key: SHELLY: That contains the move Struggle Bug...
en: SHELLY: That contains the move Struggle Bug...
ja: シェリー: それには「むしのていこう」が入ってて……

key: It's a pretty unique move in that it's both offensive and defensive.
en: It's a pretty unique move in that it's both offensive and defensive.
ja: 攻撃にも防御にも使える、結構珍しいわざなの。

key: Just... call it my thanks for, um,
en: Just... call it my thanks for, um,
ja: ただ……その、お礼だと思って、

key: Helping me deal with... e-everything.
en: Helping me deal with... e-everything.
ja: あ、あれこれ、対処するの手伝ってくれたことの。

key: SHELLY: Um...
en: SHELLY: Um...
ja: シェリー: ええと……

key: Skip Gym puzzle?
en: Skip Gym puzzle?
ja: ジムのパズルを飛ばしますか?

key: Please tell me I'm not the only one who thinks this Gym puzzle is awful.
en: Please tell me I'm not the only one who thinks this Gym puzzle is awful.
ja: このジムのパズル、ひどいと思ってるの自分だけじゃないって言ってほしいよ。

key: Thought I'd come here and grab a quick badge: after all, Bug-types can't be that threatening, can they?
en: Thought I'd come here and grab a quick badge: after all, Bug-types can't be that threatening, can they?
ja: さくっとバッジもらえると思って来たんだけどな、むしタイプなんてそんな脅威じゃないだろって。

key: But noooo, I have to solve this bookcase maze-thing first apparently, because life is never so simple.
en: But noooo, I have to solve this bookcase maze-thing first apparently, because life is never so simple.
ja: でもだめだった、まずこの本棚迷路みたいなのを解かなきゃいけないらしい、人生ってそんなに単純にはできてないんだな。

key: And it wouldn't be so bad if this made any kind of sense, but of course it doesn't.
en: And it wouldn't be so bad if this made any kind of sense, but of course it doesn't.
ja: それに、これに何か理屈があるならまだましなんだけど、当然そんなものはない。

key: I swear I've tried every combination but I still can't get up to Shelly.
en: I swear I've tried every combination but I still can't get up to Shelly.
ja: 全部の組み合わせ試したはずなのに、まだシェリーのところまでたどり着けないんだ。

key: And the other people here are completely unhelpful.
en: And the other people here are completely unhelpful.
ja: それに、ここの他の連中は全然役に立たない。

key: They're trying to give hints, but of course it's all obvious stuff and nothing that would actually help me progress.
en: They're trying to give hints, but of course it's all obvious stuff and nothing that would actually help me progress.
ja: ヒントをくれようとはしてるけど、どれも当たり前のことばっかりで、実際に先に進む役には立たないんだよな。

key: Like, why? WHY would you do this to an otherwise perfectly fine gym?
en: Like, why? WHY would you do this to an otherwise perfectly fine gym?
ja: っていうか、何で? 何でこんなことを、他は完璧なジムにやっちゃうんだよ?

key: Anyway, I've been stuck on this for a while now and I doubt I've gotten any closer to solving the puzzle.
en: Anyway, I've been stuck on this for a while now and I doubt I've gotten any closer to solving the puzzle.
ja: とにかく、もうしばらくここで詰まってて、パズルの答えに近づけてる気が全然しない。

key: If only there was something like a password system where I could tell someone "nopuzzles" so I wouldn't have to deal with this.
en: If only there was something like a password system where I could tell someone "nopuzzles" so I wouldn't have to deal with this.
ja: 誰かに「nopuzzles」って言えばこれに対処しなくて済む、みたいな合言葉システムでもあればいいのに。

key: But that kind of thing would be too convenient, right?
en: But that kind of thing would be too convenient, right?
ja: でも、そんなの都合良すぎるよな?

key: Would you like me to reset the puzzle to its original state?
en: Would you like me to reset the puzzle to its original state?
ja: パズルを最初の状態にリセットしましょうか?

key: At once.
en: At once.
ja: すぐに。

key: Best of luck.
en: Best of luck.
ja: 幸運を。

key: The other Trainers here may offer you some hints as well.
en: The other Trainers here may offer you some hints as well.
ja: ここにいる他のトレーナーたちも、ヒントをくれるかもしれません。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
